retention_audit.head: 6e4f9efbeab65e2652314f8293518dda9783778e
findings: The first partial publication anchors prior provider observations in durable manual history.
Manual reconciliation restores complete observations and replays provider evidence in observation order.
The final catalog starts from the baseline and has no scoped membership suppression stage.
Bindings declare public/account/project, region, and opaque API surface. They do not themselves prove provider-wide coverage.
Scope-aware deletion must preserve unrelated positive scope evidence, account-profile links, and canonical definitions. Do not implement deletion as unconditional provider model replacement.
retention_audit.next: Define the exact membership coverage contract, then implement suppression at its owning reconciliation seam and prove replay after partial updates and restart.

owner_question.status: No owner answer. Recommended engineering default selected for implementation.
owner_question.question: Should source membership replacement authority be explicit and separate from reply completeness?
owner_question.recommendation: Explicit membership authority; provider-wide removal requires provider-wide authority.
owner_question.constraint: Explicit membership authority remains separate from reply completeness. Preserve legacy receipts and reject account-scoped provider-wide authority.

authority_design_constraints.head: 6e4f9efbeab65e2652314f8293518dda9783778e
observations: Binding decoding rejects unknown fields and unsupported schema versions.
Receipt identity uses eleven explicit fields rather than the complete serialized binding.
The existing scope declaration does not prove upstream completeness.
required_contract: Bind any membership authority declaration to immutable receipt identity and deployment policy.
Preserve validation of existing retained receipts during migration.
Reject unsupported authority formats instead of silently ignoring them.
Keep account, region, and API restrictions separate from provider-wide catalog removal.
authority_design_constraints.status: Read-only design constraints; no schema or deletion implementation change.

membership_contract_fail_before.next: Implement binding validation and receipt identity with legacy compatibility before scoped reconciliation.
